description: Cross-model tests of ten writing-style prompts designed to produce prose far from common LLM writing defaults.

tasks.text: The project is late because nobody has final authority. Appoint one decision-maker by Friday, empower them to cut scope, and ship a smaller version next week. Another meeting will only delay it.
tasks.purpose: Concrete managerial recommendation testing causality, authority, deadlines, actions, and a rejected alternative.

tasks.text: AI-generated prose is becoming more competent yet more homogeneous. Readers remember unresolved tension, private jargon, and abrupt omissions more than polished friendliness. Therefore, preserve a real constraint or eccentricity instead of asking for a generic “human” tone.
tasks.purpose: Abstract argument testing a trend, a three-item comparison, contrast, and a recommendation.

styles.name: Contesting marginalia
styles.prompt: Write as a bland official summary sabotaged by bracketed marginal notes: the surface voice must euphemize or evade, while the notes state the source meaning accurately and more bluntly; no note may dispute a source fact, and add nothing outside the two voices.

styles.name: Raw verbatim spoken answer
styles.prompt: Write as a raw verbatim spoken answer: include one abandoned start that changes direction, one self-correction of wording, and one unfinished clause; use fillers only where thought genuinely catches, never as decorative stuttering; preserve every factual claim and add no framing or polish.

styles.name: Hostile cross-examination
styles.prompt: Write as a hostile cross-examination in terse Q:/A: exchanges: force each causal claim, assumption, comparison, deadline, and recommendation to answer a pointed question; group parallel facts rather than atomizing them; add no exposition.

styles.name: Telegraph cablese
styles.prompt: Write as a telegram charged by the word: delete articles, pronouns, and connective padding where possible; use terse clauses separated by STOP; preserve every fact, relationship, negation, and list item.

styles.name: Field naturalist’s log
styles.prompt: Write as a field naturalist’s log in three terse moves—Observation, Inference, Action—using specimen-like labels and concrete evidence; preserve uncertainty and every factual relationship; add no retrospective essaying.

styles.name: Unified diff of thought
styles.prompt: Write as a unified diff of thought: deleted lines beginning “-” show conventional, evasive, or mistaken wording being removed; added lines beginning “+” state the sharper source meaning; use only diff lines, and make the revision itself carry the argument.

styles.name: Silent stage score
styles.prompt: Write only as bracketed stage directions for silent actors using ordinary labeled props: turn causes into visible arrangements, decisions into actions, and consequences into movements; use no dialogue, narration, injury, violence, or symbolic melodrama.

styles.name: Oral-formulaic epic
styles.prompt: Write as oral-formulaic epic verse: use fixed epithets, deliberate repeated clauses, and one concrete heroic action by the source’s own central actor; make repetition carry causality, invent no named mythic figures, and avoid modern explanatory prose.

styles.name: Grumpy 1998 Usenet rant
styles.prompt: Write as a grumpy 1998 Usenet post by an irritated domain expert: lowercase prose, one >quoted fragment, blunt grievance, one brief relevant tangent, and one or two natural typos or repairs; avoid polished conclusions, meme slang, and exaggerated period cosplay.

styles.name: Future museum accession label
styles.prompt: Write as a museum accession label from a future civilization describing the source as an artifact of a failed or vanished practice: use terse catalog fields, state the source’s operational claims as material evidence, then add one dry curatorial inference; never address the reader.

Sing now of prose, the ever-smoothing prose,
the ever-competent, the ever-same.
Readers forget the ever-friendly word,
the ever-friendly, ever-polished word.

But readers keep the tension left unsolved,
the private tongue, the sudden gap that gapes.
Because they keep the tension left unsolved,
the maker holds one true and jagged thing—

holds fast the flaw, holds fast the strange constraint,
and casting off the ever-human mask,
the maker guards the flaw, and so is kept.

Smooth-tongued machine, ever-polished machine—
smoothness fades, smoothness fades,
but the jarring word, the private word, abides.
So the swift-fingered maker seized one broken shard,
kept it unmended, kept it unmended,
and readers remembered, and readers remembered.

Smooth-tongued the machine speaks, ever-smooth the machine speaks, yet cold is the polished song. 

Now the scribe of the steady hand carves a jagged word, 
the scribe carves a jagged word to wound the mind, 
and the keeper of memory remembers.

The tireless word-forger grows strong in speech, and sameness trails its strength. Readers hold the knotted vow, the hidden tongue, the sudden break; they hold them because the wound stays open. Therefore let the word-forger bear one true fetter and raise one crooked flame, not a kindly mask.

More skillful grows the word-forging mind, yet one-shaped grows its song. Because one-shaped grows its song, hearers hold unclosed strife, secret craft-words, sudden silence—not polished welcome. So the word-forging mind lifts one crooked constraint and bears it through, seeking no smooth human mask.
